Reject the new security proposal as duplicate admission. The canonical read-only security evidence matrix is already in progress. Continue that existing work only; keep security-sensitive releases and gated public exposure blocked until dated control evidence and owner disposition exist.

Revenue, ROI, margin, and causal-lift claims remain unsupported: available affiliate commission is aggregate and unattributed. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, so the three evidence-backed implementation candidates below are routed to engineer but capacity-gated.
